label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to _____ it and to keep it.
verse: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
note: Work came before the fall, not after it — Adam's first job description was to dress and keep a garden.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, _____ that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
verse: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
note: Said the morning after the fig tree withered: faith that prays expects an answer.

label: Sunday School
prompt: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the _____, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verse: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
note: Free fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, garlic — Israel waxing nostalgic about Egypt's menu and forgetting the slavery.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the wicked are like the _____ sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verse: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
note: The restless sea keeps churning up mud — Isaiah's picture of a life with no peace.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Behold now _____, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verse: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
note: God points Job to 'behemoth,' a grass-eating giant: 'he is the chief of the ways of God' (40:19).
